definitions.ask: What should the root-parent bar call time spent on tasks defined in daily notes?
definitions.why: True over multi-day ranges, never mistaken for a note, names where the tasks live

choices.label: `<daily>`: brackets mark a synthetic root, like `<stdin>`; matches the `#daily` tag
`<day>`: shorter, but reads like a unit of time (`<day> 55m`)
`daily`: matches `unlinked`/`unfiled`, but looks like a real note stem

definitions.ask: Should links to any task defined in a daily note (not just `^gtd`) count under `<daily>` instead of `unfiled`?
definitions.why: The label then means exactly what it says; only `^gtd` is linked today, so history is unchanged

choices.label: Every daily-note block attributes to `<daily>`; one more branch in bob and the plugin chip mirror
Only review buckets roll up to `<daily>`; other daily-note tasks stay `unfiled`

definitions.ask: Should PLAN review keep the orange gtd area via a new root vault note `plan.md` whose parent is gtd?
definitions.why: The research verified it in a scratch vault and it keeps six months of area history in place

choices.label: Create `~/bob/plan.md`; review keeps the gtd area, orange chip dot, and area history
No vault note; review becomes its own grey `PLAN review` area, since `plan` is ambiguous
